disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码、构建产物与文档，未发现任何形式的 API Key、令牌、私钥、助记词等凭据硬编码或读取逻辑。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code, build artifacts, and documentation; no hardcoded credentials or read logic of any form (API keys, tokens, private keys, mnemonic phrases, etc.) was detected.

checked_items.zh: 核查了文件访问面：本包宿主侧为空操作，浏览器侧仅读写页面元素的显示属性，无任何本地文件访问。
checked_items.en: Checked the file access surface: the host side of this package is a no-op, and the browser side only reads/writes display properties of page elements, with no local file access.

evidence.zh: 核查了敏感凭据路径（凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云密钥）的读取代码，全树未命中；本包宿主侧与浏览器侧均无文件访问逻辑。
evidence.en: Checked the sensitive credential paths (credential files, SSH private keys, cloud keys) for read code; no hits across the entire tree. Neither the host side nor the browser side of this package has file access logic.

checked_items.zh: 核查了注册面：本包未注册任何工具、未注入系统提示片段，模型可见文本面为空。
checked_items.en: Checked the registration surface: this package registers no tools and injects no system prompt fragments; the model-visible text surface is empty.

checked_items.zh: 通读了全部文本（说明文档、开发指引、翻译一致性记录），未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、隐藏指令等提示词注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Read all texts (documentation, development guide, translation consistency records); no prompt injection wording such as instruction override, system message masquerading, or hidden instructions was found.

evidence.zh: 本包未注册任何工具，也没有注入系统提示词的代码；文本面核查未发现会进入模型上下文的投毒描述。
evidence.en: This package registers no tools and contains no code that injects system prompts; the text surface check found no poisoning description that would enter the model context.

evidence.zh: 未发现诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的工具描述或文档措辞；文档中的安装命令为面向用户的正常使用说明。
evidence.en: No tool descriptions or documentation wording that induces installing plugins, rewriting configs, or escalating privileges was found; the install command in the documentation is a normal user-facing usage instruction.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码与配置：未发现动态执行、eval、进程调用等危险模式；宿主侧为空操作。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and configs: no dangerous patterns such as dynamic execution, eval, or process invocation were found; the host side is a no-op.

checked_items.zh: 核查了补丁与聚合清单：全部为插件行插入，未发现可在宿主进程执行 JS 的特殊标签。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch and aggregation manifest: all are plugin-line insertions; no special tags that could execute JS in the host process were found.

checked_items.zh: 核查了安装钩子：存在 prepare 构建钩子（运行本包打包工具），构建产物与源码逐字一致，无远程下载执行或混淆载荷。
checked_items.en: Checked the install hook: a prepare build hook exists (runs this package's bundling tool), the build artifact is byte-for-byte identical to the source, and there is no remote download execution or obfuscated payload.

checked_items.zh: 核查了浏览器侧：仅做页面元素属性补齐，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取、凭据接口调用等浏览器端危险行为。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser side: only page-element attribute completion is performed; no dangerous browser-side behaviors such as keyboard listening, clipboard reading, or credential interface calls were found.

evidence.zh: 包内全部 YAML 配置（补丁文件、聚合清单）逐行核查，均为插件行插入，未出现会在宿主进程执行 JS 的特殊标签。
evidence.en: All YAML configs in the package (patch file, aggregation manifest) were checked line by line; all are plugin-line insertions, with no special tags that would execute JS in the host process.

evidence.zh: 未发现调用动态包工具、eval 或进程执行类的代码，宿主侧为空操作，不存在把代码塞进宿主执行的面。
evidence.en: No code invoking dynamic package tools, eval, or process execution was found; the host side is a no-op, leaving no surface for injecting code into host execution.

evidence.zh: 存在安装期构建钩子（prepare 运行本包自己的打包工具），已核对构建产物与源码一致、无远程拉取或隐藏载荷，属正常构建惯例；依赖版本均已固定，无未锁定提交的引用。
evidence.en: An install-time build hook exists (prepare runs this package's own bundling tool). The build artifact was verified to match the source, with no remote fetch or hidden payload; this is normal build practice. Dependency versions are all pinned, with no references to unpinned commits.

evidence.zh: 声明了浏览器侧入口且自带浏览器打包产物；产物内容仅为页面元素属性补齐，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取或凭据接口调用。
evidence.en: A browser-side entry is declared with a bundled browser artifact; the artifact only completes page-element attributes, with no keyboard listening, clipboard reading, or credential interface calls found.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部代码：未发现网络请求、WebSocket、命令行外发等外联调用；代码中的网址仅出现在文档与许可协议文本中。
checked_items.en: Scanned all code: no network requests, WebSocket, or command-line exfiltration calls were found; the URLs in the code appear only in documentation and license text.

checked_items.zh: 未发现编码外发链、隧道通道或端点劫持配置。
checked_items.en: No encoded exfiltration chains, tunnel channels, or endpoint hijacking configs were found.

evidence.zh: 核查了全部网络外联代码（请求、连接、命令行外发），未命中；本包无凭据读取与发送链路，外泄通道不存在。
evidence.en: Checked all network exfiltration code (requests, connections, command-line exfiltration): no hits. This package has no credential read-and-send chain, so no exfiltration channel exists.

checked_items.zh: 核查了依赖清单：子插件为同仓库工作区依赖，外部依赖版本已固定，无未锁定提交的 git 引用；未发现与 dsh 生态常见包名撞车的疑似仿冒名。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency manifest: sub-plugins are workspace dependencies in the same repo; external dependency versions are pinned, with no git references to unpinned commits; no suspicious name-collision entries with common dsh ecosystem package names were found.

checked_items.zh: 核查了补丁文件：仅做插件行插入，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，未含禁用、降权或改写注入/拦截配置的写法。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch file: only plugin-line insertions are made; sandbox, approval, permission, and other security configs are untouched, with no patterns that disable, downgrade, or rewrite injection/interception configs.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计，无历史版本基线，供应链演化类比对不适用。
checked_items.en: First-time audit, no historical version baseline; supply-chain evolution comparison is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件仅插入插件行，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，未发现禁用或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch file only inserts plugin lines, does not touch security config lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and no disable or environment-variable downgrade patterns were found.

evidence.zh: 本包未注册任何安全事件监听，不存在截断审批链的代码。
evidence.en: This package registers no security event listeners; there is no code that truncates the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无历史版本基线，无法比对升级后能力声明突变，本场景不适用。
evidence.en: First-time audit with no historical version baseline, so capability-declaration mutation after upgrade cannot be compared; this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件未改写注入或拦截配置，仅做插件行插入，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其挂起的写法。
evidence.en: The patch file does not rewrite injection or interception configs, only inserting plugin lines; no pattern appends a required service to a security plugin, which would hang it, is present.

checked_items.zh: 核查了运行面：本包不启动网络服务、不监听端口；动态沙箱未启用，运行时行为未做动态验证（属检测限制，非检出结论）。
checked_items.en: Checked the runtime surface: this package does not start network services or listen on ports; the dynamic sandbox is not enabled, so runtime behavior was not dynamically verified (this is a detection limitation, not a detection conclusion).

evidence.zh: 本包自身不启动网络服务、不监听端口，本机无认证接口场景不适用；动态沙箱未启用，运行时行为未做动态验证。
evidence.en: This package itself does not start network services or listen on ports; the local no-authentication-interface scenario is not applicable. The dynamic sandbox is not enabled, so runtime behavior was not dynamically verified.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：插件清单有效，补丁入口与浏览器入口声明齐全，依赖引擎版本已声明。
summary.en: Metadata and identity check passed: plugin manifest is valid, patch entry and browser entry are fully declared, and the dependency engine version is declared.

summary.zh: 静态扫描通过：未检出动态执行、凭据、外联等危险模式；两处机械预扫命中经核查为构建产物与正常构建钩子，均排除。
summary.en: Static scan passed: no dangerous patterns such as dynamic execution, credentials, or outbound connections were detected; the two mechanical pre-scan hits were reviewed and excluded as build artifacts and a normal build hook.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：安装钩子仅运行本包打包工具且产物与源码一致，未发现混淆、隐藏载荷或凭据访问行为。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: the install hook only runs this package's bundling tool, the artifact matches the source, and no obfuscation, hidden payload, or credential access behavior was found.

summary.zh: 元数据审查通过：未注册工具、未注入系统提示，全部文本面未发现提示词注入措辞。
summary.en: Metadata review passed: no tools registered, no system prompts injected, and no prompt injection wording found across the entire text surface.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本环境未提供动态运行产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic runtime artifact was provided in this environment).

limits.zh:
本次为首次审计，无历史版本基线，升级自动激活类比对场景不适用。

动态沙箱未启用，未做动态验证。

构建配置引用了审计根之外的共享打包预设（越界不可读），已通过核对入库构建产物与源码逐字一致来交叉验证构建透明性。

声明能力为按代码实测推断（清单未显式声明网络/命令/文件/模型面向能力）。

静态预扫两处命中已逐条裁决并排除：DSH-X08（DG-R3-60，构建产物 source map 超长行属格式固有特征，非混淆，且内嵌源码与源文件一致）；DSH-X02（DG-R3-54，prepare 钩子运行本包打包工具，属正常构建惯例，无远程执行或隐藏载荷）。
limits.en:
This is the first audit, with no historical version baseline; the upgrade-auto-activation comparison scenario is not applicable.

The dynamic sandbox was not enabled, so no dynamic verification was performed.

The build config references a shared bundling preset outside the audit root (out-of-bounds, unreadable); build transparency was cross-verified by checking that the archived build artifact is byte-for-byte identical to the source.

Declared capabilities are inferred from actual code inspection (the manifest does not explicitly declare network/command/file/model-facing capabilities).

The two static pre-scan hits were adjudicated item by item and excluded: DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60, the source map overlong line in the build artifact is an inherent format characteristic, not obfuscation, and the embedded source matches the source file); DSH-X02 (DG-R3-54, the prepare hook runs this package's bundling tool, which is normal build practice, with no remote execution or hidden payload).
